title: fix(auth): sync platform name with GitHub on login
author: Saauf
pr_body_excerpt:
### Summary
Currently, `enter.pollinations.ai` only syncs `github_username` on subsequent logins via `onAfterSessionCreate`, while `user.name` is never updated after initial registration. If a user changes their display name or username on GitHub, their platform name displayed across the dashboard (`data.user?.name || data.githubUsername`) and API responses remains stale with their old name.

This PR updates `onAfterSessionCreate` to:
- Retrieve `name` alongside `githubId` and `githubUsername` from `userTable`.
- Fetch the user's latest GitHub profile, determining their current GitHub name (`profile.name || profile.login`).
- Compare both `user.name` and `user.githubUsername`, updating `userTable` if either has changed.
- No UI changes.

### Testing
- Added unit/integration tests in `enter.pollinations.ai/test/username-sync.test.ts` covering:
  - Synchronizing updated name and username when GitHub profile changes.
  - Falling back to GitHub login when GitHub display name is empty.
- Ran tests via `npx vitest run test/username-sync.test.ts` (all passed).
- Verified `npx biome check` and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass cleanly.

Fixes #15373

gist.headline: Names follow the pollen
gist.blurb: GitHub name changes now make it through the hive on login. Polli has stopped addressing people by their previous internet selves.
gist.summary: The auth login hook now fetches each returning user's latest GitHub profile and updates both user.name and github_username in enter.pollinations.ai, using the GitHub login when no display name is set.
gist.impact: Dashboard displays and API responses now reflect a user's current GitHub display name or username after they log in, rather than keeping the name from initial registration.
